description:
St. Olaf students are invited to register to attend the 54th Annual Traditional Mahkato Wacipi (Pow Wow) Trip to Mankato, MN.

This trip organized by the Taylor Center is an opportunity for all students to learn about Dakota Culture in Minnesota.

RSVP HERE!

Trip Details:

  • Free transportation and entrance ticket to registered participants is provided.
  • Food is available for purchase from vendors in-site.
  • Departure from Buntrock Commons: 11:45 a.m. | Return from event: 3:00 p.m.
  • Location: Dakota Wokiksuye Makoce (Land of Memories Park), Mankato, Minnesota.
  • All attendees are expected to follow the Guidelines for Visitors from The Mahkato Mdewakanton Association.

Welcome to the Move-in Mixer event with an evening of fun, food, and new friendships on Friday September 4th at 8pm on Thorson Lawn. 

We invite all first year students to an evening of exploration and connection. Each residentwill receive  a passport and collect stamps by visiting different stations. There will be 8 stations including pizza, s'mores, a dirty soda bar, friendship bracelets, and lawn games, to name a few!  At 9pm, residents will be invited to participate in a big game of capture the flag with their respective residence halls. 

After completing a passport, individuals will receive raffle entries to enter to win a variety of exciting prizes. 

We can't wait to kick off the school year with a night to remember! Hope to see you there.

The Wellness Center presents "Beyond the Mirror", a presentation geared towards the challenges of First-Year Student life that is focused on identifying ways to cope with self-image and body image. Wellness Center Peer Educators discuss with students why body image issues arise in academic/college situations and how students can cope with them, especially in new environments. The presentation will include an honest conversation about self-image in adult life, along with interactive elements to help students open up about a serious topic in a lighter way. Join us in Holland Hall 523 to learn more!

Come join the Wellness Center Substance Team to learn more about our relationships with substances, how to define and build healthy relationships with them, and what that can look like for you. Which can all be encompassed by the phrase 'My Chemical Romance'.

In this presentation, students will explore the gray area of consent in several parts of their lives. They should take away a broader more multifaceted understanding of how their needs and others needs can coexist and best be met in a college environment.

Come and join the Wellness Center’s substance team as they present Muppet Myopia: Alcohol 101! This presentation is tailored to the freshmen experience, focusing on the impacts of alcohol as a substance. We will discuss strategies to form smart relationships and boundaries with alcohol.

Let’s learn about periods and the pain that accompanies it, as well as how it impacts our wellbeing. It is a struggle that many face when it comes to period pain that affects us both internally and externally. Through discussion-based conversation and with real-life period stimulators, we will explore what happens in the bodies of those who experience period, how to potentially combat it, and build empathy for one another.

In this presentation, St. Olaf students will delve into the various ways that they can stay physically active without being involved in a strenuous workout program or a sport on campus. The Wellness Center will share ideas and information regarding healthy activities for busy college students who may not have the time to dedicate to a high-intensity workout plan. Students will explore the academic, emotional, and social benefits of staying active regularly throughout their college journey on the Hill.
